title: When the Autopsy Wakes
author: Jonah Kavanagh
blurb: August Nakamura, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
